$description: Calendar (platform/components/Calendar, library wave 7, lane A): its component tokens. Today is DateBadge's today (the action color), a chosen day the selected state, a range the selected fill between its ends; every color an existing role.

calendar-months-gap.$description: Calendar with two months: the space between the months (and between their lines when they stack).

calendar-month-gap.$description: Calendar month: the space between the month's header and its grid.

calendar-header-min-height.$description: Calendar header: its least height (the arrow buttons' height).

calendar-header-gap.$description: Calendar header: the space between the arrows and the month's name.

calendar-nav-space-size.$description: Calendar header: the room kept where a month of two has no arrow, so both names stay centered over their grids.

calendar-title-font-size.$description: Calendar header: the month's name size.

calendar-title-font-weight.$description: Calendar header: the month's name weight.

calendar-weekday-text.$description: Calendar: the weekday names over the columns.

calendar-weekday-font-size.$description: Calendar: the weekday names' size (DateBadge's weekday size).

calendar-weekday-height.$description: Calendar: the height of the weekday row.

calendar-cell-size.$description: Calendar: the width and height of a day (the standard control height of the density; 44px on touch).

calendar-day-radius.$description: Calendar day: its corners (DateBadge's day: round).

calendar-day-border-width.$description: Calendar day: its edge (clear until it is hovered or chosen).

calendar-day-hover-background.$description: Calendar day with the pointer over it: the hover fill.

calendar-day-hover-border-color.$description: Calendar day with the pointer over it: the hover edge.

calendar-day-focus-outline-color.$description: Calendar day with keyboard focus: the focus outline, drawn inside the day (the navigation list's).

calendar-day-focus-outline-width.$description: Calendar day with keyboard focus: the outline's width.

calendar-day-focus-outline-offset.$description: Calendar day with keyboard focus: the outline sits inside the day.

calendar-day-today-background.$description: Calendar today: DateBadge's today fill (the action color).

calendar-day-today-text.$description: Calendar today: the number on the action color.

calendar-day-selected-background.$description: Calendar chosen day (and a range's two ends): the selected fill.

calendar-day-selected-border-color.$description: Calendar chosen day: the selected edge.

calendar-day-selected-text.$description: Calendar chosen day: the number in the selected content color.

calendar-day-selected-font-weight.$description: Calendar chosen day: the number's weight.

calendar-day-outside-text.$description: Calendar: a day of the weeks around the month (one month shown).

calendar-day-disabled-text.$description: Calendar: a day that cannot be chosen.

calendar-range-background.$description: Calendar range: the fill between the start and the end (and behind the ends' inner halves).

calendar-range-text.$description: Calendar range: the numbers between the start and the end.

calendar-range-half.$description: Calendar range: at the start and the end the fill covers the cell's inner half only.

calendar-week-number-text.$description: Calendar week numbers: the number before each week.

calendar-week-number-font-family.$description: Calendar week numbers: the data font (Reddit Mono).

calendar-week-number-font-size.$description: Calendar week numbers: their size (the weekday names').
